instruction: A warehouse starts with 950 boxes. It ships 40 boxes per day for 6 days. Every shipped box is loaded onto a pallet of 20 boxes. How many trucks were used? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
